def: The total greenhouse gas produced by a person or activity.
ex: Air travel dominates the average carbon footprint.

def: The suppression of speech or writing.
ex: Censorship drove the debate underground.

def: A means through which something is conveyed.
ex: Savings are channelled into productive investment.

def: A main division of a book, or a distinct period.
ex: The closure opened a difficult chapter for the town.

def: Relating to substances and their reactions.
ex: Chemical runoff has poisoned the estuary.

def: Persisting over a long period.
ex: Chronic illness accounts for most health spending.

def: To quote a source as evidence for an argument.
ex: The paper cites forty separate studies.

def: To make something easier to understand.
ex: The minister clarified the timetable under questioning.

def: A distinct section of a legal document or sentence.
ex: A single clause voided the whole warranty.

def: A system of rules or symbols.
ex: The profession has a strict code of conduct.

def: Relating to thinking, learning and understanding.
ex: Sleep loss impairs cognitive performance sharply.

def: The state of forming a united, connected whole.
ex: Social cohesion weakened as inequality grew.

def: To begin, especially something formal.
ex: Construction commenced in the spring.

def: A group appointed to investigate, or an order for work.
ex: A royal commission reported after two years.

def: To travel regularly between home and work.
ex: Many now commute only twice a week.

def: Able to exist or work together without conflict.
ex: Growth is not always compatible with conservation.

def: Powerfully convincing.
ex: A compelling case for early intervention.

def: To make up for a loss or disadvantage.
ex: Nothing compensates for the loss of habitat.

def: A part that combines with others to form a whole.
ex: Labour is the largest single component of cost.

def: To make a problem worse by adding to it.
ex: Poor housing compounds every health inequality.

def: To calculate a figure or amount.
ex: The model computes risk across ten variables.

def: An abstract idea or general notion.
ex: The concept of sustainability resists precise definition.

def: To grant a right or title, or to discuss together.
ex: The degree confers no automatic right to practise.

def: Overcrowding, especially of traffic.
ex: Congestion costs the city billions each year.

def: General agreement among a group.
ex: No consensus emerged after eight hours.

def: Permission for something to happen.
ex: Data may not be shared without consent.

def: The protection of nature or resources from loss.
ex: Conservation efforts saved the last breeding pairs.

def: To be composed of particular parts.
ex: The panel consists of nine elected members.

def: To limit or restrict what can be done.
ex: Budgets constrain what any school can offer.

def: To build or form something by assembling parts.
ex: The argument is carefully constructed from primary sources.

def: To seek information or advice from someone.
ex: Residents were never properly consulted.

def: A binding written agreement.
ex: The contract runs for three years.

def: A striking difference between two things.
ex: The contrast between the two districts is stark.

def: To bring people together for a meeting.
ex: The committee convenes twice a year.

def: To change something into a different form or use.
ex: Warehouses were converted into flats.

def: Relating to a large company or group.
ex: Corporate sponsorship funds most of the tournament.

def: Recognition for an achievement, or borrowed money.
ex: Cheap credit fuelled the housing boom.

def: To restrain or keep something in check.
ex: The tax was designed to curb consumption.

def: The subjects taught in a school or course.
ex: The curriculum was narrowed to core subjects.

def: Involving imprisonment.
ex: Custodial sentences rose while crime fell.
